data.name: UK Carbon Registry
data.description: UK Carbon Registry (UKCR) is a UK-based carbon credit registry that onboards, validates, issues, tracks and retires carbon credits for projects following ISO 14064 and CDM-aligned methodologies. It focuses on STEM-based carbon avoidance and removal projects (solar, EV charging, water purification, waste management, wind, and removal technologies). It is a registry/standards body, not a CO2 remover itself.
